message: DEBUG must default to off and come from the environment — debug pages expose source, settings and locals.
SECRET_KEY must come from the environment — a committed key lets anyone forge sessions.
List the hostnames you serve — a wildcard enables Host header attacks.
Pass parameters to .raw()/.extra() instead of formatting them in — this is SQL injection.
`.objects.get()` raises DoesNotExist/MultipleObjectsReturned — use `get_object_or_404`, or handle both explicitly.
